purpose: Test one current-state measurement correction implied by V110's near-pass: use exact remaining CPU work for runnable resident tasks instead of re-counting their full immutable function CPU, while freezing pending work, same-window projected work, the 50-frame causal horizon, and every other V110 certificate.

v110_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.only_failed_gate: E3.spike5x50ms throughput: candidate 0.4316666667 vs anchor 0.432 requests/ms, relative -0.0771605%, with two of three nonnegative seed deltas
v110_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.successful_pattern: All six QPR gates passed; sustained and pulse throughput improved by 7.9202% and 7.9292% respectively.
v110_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.remaining_measurement_mismatch: V110 correctly sums heterogeneous functions but counts the full immutable Func.cpu for every runnable resident task even after that task has already consumed CPU. RunningTask.left_calc is the simulator's exact current remaining compute work and is decremented by the execution loop each frame.
v110_mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.interpretation: The next independent axis is fidelity of the runnable work observation, not a ratio, horizon, arrival threshold, scenario-specific rule, or result-dependent safety margin.

frozen_parent_profiles.V110_temporal_and_service_certificate: 50-frame 3/2 causal activation with maximum candidate-to-anchor service proxy ratio 9/10

closed_axes.causal_horizon_refitting: 25 and 50 tested in V109; V111 fixes 50
closed_axes.critical_service_ratio_refitting: 9/10 and 4/5 tested in V108; V111 fixes 9/10
closed_axes.arrival_rate_threshold_refitting: 3/2 and 2/1 tested in V107; V111 fixes 3/2
closed_axes.pending_work_definition: V111 retains one immutable Func.cpu per pending task from V110
closed_axes.same_window_projected_work_definition: V111 retains one immutable Func.cpu per already assigned player and the current player from V110

hypothesis.primary: V110's remaining spike throughput miss is caused in part by over-counting already consumed CPU on runnable tasks. Replacing only that component with exact current left_calc will preserve V110's QPR and sustained/pulse gains while eliminating the residual spike throughput loss.
hypothesis.candidate: Retain the exact V110 mechanism, but sum RunningTask.left_calc for currently runnable resident tasks; pending and same-window projected tasks retain full immutable Func.cpu.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E902-E904 cohort.

allowed: the frozen V110 first-seen request history, 3/2 shock certificate, and 50-frame activation deadline
the immutable raw CPU of each pending task
the current finite nonnegative RunningTask.left_calc of each resident task that is runnable under the execution loop's container, parent, and data gates
the immutable raw CPU of functions already assigned in the current deterministic scheduling window and of the current player
every immutable and current-state V110 locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier input
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
parent-blocked, data-blocked, or cold-start-blocked resident tasks in the current execution-work term
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, or registered burst interval as a routing input
E899-E901 result-dependent threshold, ratio, horizon, or scenario refitting
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.arrival_and_activation_definition: Bit-for-bit V110/V109 horizon50: 80-frame baseline, 20-frame recent first-seen ReqId history, at least 20 requests in each, exact 3/2 integer comparison, deadline current_frame+49.
information_boundary.current_queue_work_definition: For a node, sum immutable Func.cpu once for every pending task and current RunningTask.left_calc once for every runnable resident task. Iterate pending tasks, function IDs, and request IDs in sorted order and accumulate in f64. Blocked resident tasks are excluded.
information_boundary.same_window_projected_work_definition: Sum immutable Func.cpu for every player already assigned to the node in the current AssignmentState, then add the current player's immutable Func.cpu exactly once.
information_boundary.candidate_service_proxy: remote_parent_transfer_time + cold_start_frames_if_not_warm + (pending_immutable_cpu_work + runnable_remaining_cpu_work + same_window_projected_immutable_cpu_work + current_player_immutable_cpu_work) / node_cpu_capacity.
information_boundary.anchor_service_proxy: The identical formula evaluated on the frozen anchor node and the same pre-current-player AssignmentState.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any missing task/function, non-finite or negative left_calc/CPU work, invalid capacity/bandwidth, incomplete parent placement, or arithmetic overflow makes the proxy unavailable and preserves the anchor assignment.

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: the runnable portion of the V110 exact CPU-work observation changes from full immutable Func.cpu to current RunningTask.left_calc
candidate_mechanism.eligible_players_and_certificates: Bit-for-bit V110: tied maximum remaining-critical-path frontier players only, exact noncritical V94 anchor, 9/10 individual proxy, warm/parent/child locality and CPU/memory headroom noninferiority, routed-score noninferiority, strictly lower complete critical proxy, nonworse routed/OCS/immutable-baseline welfare, and V94 coordination guards.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without sufficient history, an active horizon, a finite remaining-work proxy, or a certified critical substitution, dispatch exact V94 for identical current state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V110 causal-arrival and critical-service fields
pending immutable CPU work, runnable remaining CPU work, same-window projected immutable CPU work, and unavailable-input counters
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V111 profile
